final: SELECT AVG(avg_replacement_cost_usd), AVG(avg_fee_per_day_usd), AVG(avg_fee_per_day_usd - overall_avg_fee_per_day_usd) FROM (SELECT rating, AVG(replacement_cost) AS avg_replacement_cost_usd, AVG(rental_rate / rental_duration) AS avg_fee_per_day_usd FROM film GROUP BY rating) AS per_rating JOIN (SELECT AVG(rental_rate / rental_duration) AS overall_avg_fee_per_day_usd FROM film) AS overall ON 1 = 1 WHERE per_rating.avg_fee_per_day_usd > overall.overall_avg_fee_per_day_usd
